model: PATEK PHILIPPE Aquanaut 5168G (42.2 mm white gold, blue embossed dial, blue composite rubber strap)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot (at hand height). Blue 5168G (catalog 2 row 104; the SKU repeats with row 102 green): same structure as config/watches/patek-aquanaut42-5168g-green.json (follower of the 5167A template: case slab from the alpha silhouette, superellipse bezel ring with scanned window and chamfer, flat polygon dial with the native photo map, one fluted crown, one-piece rubber strap), re-measured on the blue photo at 42.2 mm (scale 29.72 px/mm): case tips 24.25 / 26.5 mm, hand angles and centre-line offsets, crown, strap pieces and emissions are per photo. Step and kit lighting are the template's.

case.note: case slab = silhouette between the lug tips (tip_top / tip_bottom, 0.25 mm grid, sum a multiple of 0.25) with the crown rows replaced by a straight line, top and bottom sloping toward the strap; bezel = superellipse ring (min of the superellipse and the silhouette less silhouette_margin_mm, sampled by rays) at bezel_z, then a chamfer ring down to the dial window at chamfer_z

dial.note: flat polygon (the window less the chamfer) with the native photo map: embossed grid, applied numerals, indices, minute track, date window and the photographed hands stay in the map

hands.note: profile = [mm along the hand from the pivot (negative = tail), half width] from tail to tip, last point at the traced length; mm profile of the 5168G green template (the same hand set; checked on the blue photo: lume half 15.0 / 14.8 px, frame half about 27 px, tail end about 152 px), placed at the blue photo's angles (hour 303.58, minute 51.08, seconds 179.51 deg) and centre-line offsets (trace hands.offset_mm). lume = [s, half width] of the pale inlay. Hands and hub use hands_photo (reference photo projected from the front)

crown.note: crowns come from trace.crowns: a lathe about the axis (profile = [radius, mm along the axis] from the base point), flutes are texture

strap.note: strap.kind rubber, ONE full-width piece: edges = trace.strap_y_left_right_mm (silhouette outside the lug zone, measured lug inner walls inside it), from under the bezel (18.5 mm) to the rounded ends; the embossed grid pad of the photo is texture only

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
